'''Tam''' was an [[Iyra]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krinemonen III]]. When Tam's cousin, the [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]], fled persecution by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who were angry over his pro-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] attitudes, Tam gave the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] safe haven.<ref name="G8">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}}</ref>
